title: Why We Blew Up Four Dams — and Saved a River | Amy Bowers Cordalis | TED
speaker: TED
zh: 【TED】為什麼我們炸毀了四座水壩並拯救了一條河流艾米·鮑爾斯·科達利斯 | 艾米·鮑爾斯·科達利斯泰德（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: In the beginning, there were shapeless spirits roaming the universe.
cues.en: In the beginning, there were shapeless spirits roaming the universe.
cues.zh: 起初，有無形的靈魂在宇宙中游盪。

cues.text: And they went to the creator and said, "We are lonely.
cues.en: And they went to the creator and said, "We are lonely.
cues.zh: 他們去找創作者說：「我們很孤獨。

cues.text: Please help us." And the creator said, "I will make you a place to be together,
cues.en: Please help us." And the creator said, "I will make you a place to be together,
cues.zh: 請幫助我們。創作者說：「我會給你們一個可以在一起的地方，

cues.text: on one condition.
cues.en: on one condition.
cues.zh: 在一個條件下。

cues.text: You must take care of it." The spirits agreed.
cues.en: You must take care of it." The spirits agreed.
cues.zh: 你必須照顧好它。 「精靈們同意了。

cues.text: And the creator made the Earth and sent the spirits down to the Earth
cues.en: And the creator made the Earth and sent the spirits down to the Earth
cues.zh: 造物主創造了地球並將靈魂送到地球

cues.text: to become land and water, plants, animals and humans,
cues.en: to become land and water, plants, animals and humans,
cues.zh: 變成土地和水、植物、動物和人類，

cues.text: making everything on Earth alive.
cues.en: making everything on Earth alive.
cues.zh: 讓地球上的一切都生氣勃勃。

cues.text: The creator told my ancestors, "You will never want for anything,
cues.en: The creator told my ancestors, "You will never want for anything,
cues.zh: 造物主告訴我的祖先：「你永遠不會想要任何東西，

cues.text: so long as you live in a balance with the natural world.
cues.en: so long as you live in a balance with the natural world.
cues.zh: 只要你與自然世界保持平衡。

cues.text: Never take more than what you need.
cues.en: Never take more than what you need.
cues.zh: 切勿拿取超出您所需的東西。

cues.text: Give thanks. And protect what gives you life.” That is a version of my nation, the Yurok tribe's, creation story.
cues.en: Give thanks. And protect what gives you life.” That is a version of my nation, the Yurok tribe's, creation story.
cues.zh: 表示感謝。並保護賦予你生命的東西。 」這是我的國家尤洛克部落的創世故事的一個版本。

cues.text: It's not spiritual parable.
cues.en: It's not spiritual parable.
cues.zh: 這不是屬靈的比喻。

cues.text: It's a set of instructions.
cues.en: It's a set of instructions.
cues.zh: 這是一組指令。

cues.text: Simple, practical rules about how humans are meant to live on Earth.
cues.en: Simple, practical rules about how humans are meant to live on Earth.
cues.zh: 關於人類如何在地球上生活的簡單實用的規則。

cues.text: I want to tell you a story of loss,
cues.en: I want to tell you a story of loss,
cues.zh: 我想告訴你一個失去的故事

cues.text: resilience and victory, and what it means to remember.
cues.en: resilience and victory, and what it means to remember.
cues.zh: 韌性和勝利，以及記住意味著什麼。

cues.text: Since time immemorial, my nation has lived by these instructions.
cues.en: Since time immemorial, my nation has lived by these instructions.
cues.zh: 自古以來，我國就一直遵循這些指示。

cues.text: The lower Klamath River, in what is now known as Northern California,
cues.en: The lower Klamath River, in what is now known as Northern California,
cues.zh: 克拉馬斯河下游，即現在的北加州，

cues.text: is our home and our lifeblood.
cues.en: is our home and our lifeblood.
cues.zh: 是我們的家，是我們的命脈。

cues.text: Under our stewardship, the Klamath salmon runs grew to be the third largest
cues.en: Under our stewardship, the Klamath salmon runs grew to be the third largest
cues.zh: 在我們的管理下，克拉馬斯鮭魚養殖場成長為第三大鮭魚養殖場

cues.text: in all the continental US.
cues.en: in all the continental US.
cues.zh: 在整個美國本土。

cues.text: We had an abundant fishing way of life,
cues.en: We had an abundant fishing way of life,
cues.zh: 我們有豐富的捕魚生活方式，

cues.text: caring for all that gave us life.
cues.en: caring for all that gave us life.
cues.zh: 關心給予我們生命的一切。

cues.text: Then in the 1800s, everything changed.
cues.en: Then in the 1800s, everything changed.
cues.zh: 然後到了 1800 年代，一切都改變了。

cues.text: Newcomers arrived, and they viewed our world through the lens of extraction:
cues.en: Newcomers arrived, and they viewed our world through the lens of extraction:
cues.zh: 新來者到來，他們透過提取的視角來看我們的世界：

cues.text: gold, timber, water, land and people.
cues.en: gold, timber, water, land and people.
cues.zh: 黃金、木材、水、土地和人民。

cues.text: The balance was disrupted, and suffering ensued in this place.
cues.en: The balance was disrupted, and suffering ensued in this place.
cues.zh: 平衡被打破，這裡的痛苦隨之而來。

cues.text: By 1910, over 90 percent of California's Indigenous population had been slaughtered.
cues.en: By 1910, over 90 percent of California's Indigenous population had been slaughtered.
cues.zh: 到 1910 年，超過 90% 的加州原住民被屠殺。

cues.text: It was genocide.
cues.en: It was genocide.
cues.zh: 這是種族滅絕。

cues.text: By the 2000s, the Klamath River, our ancient relative,
cues.en: By the 2000s, the Klamath River, our ancient relative,
cues.zh: 到了 2000 年代，我們古老的親戚克拉馬斯河，

cues.text: had been transformed by dams, habitat loss, water diversions
cues.en: had been transformed by dams, habitat loss, water diversions
cues.zh: 因水壩、棲息地喪失、水改道而改變

cues.text: and warming polluted waters.
cues.en: and warming polluted waters.
cues.zh: 並使受汙染的水域變暖。

cues.text: The dams, built without fish passage, blocked the salmon from accessing over 400 miles
cues.en: The dams, built without fish passage, blocked the salmon from accessing over 400 miles
cues.zh: 這些水壩沒有魚道，阻止了鮭魚進入超過 400 英里的地方

cues.text: of historical spawning grounds.
cues.en: of historical spawning grounds.
cues.zh: 歷史產卵場。

cues.text: Our salmon runs fell to five percent of their historical abundance.
cues.en: Our salmon runs fell to five percent of their historical abundance.
cues.zh: 我們的鮭魚捕撈量下降至歷史豐度的百分之五。

cues.text: The hydropower from the dams wasn't green either.
cues.en: The hydropower from the dams wasn't green either.
cues.zh: 大壩的水力發電也不是綠色的。

cues.text: The reservoirs behind the dams emitted methane, the equivalent to 64,000 cars a year on the road.
cues.en: The reservoirs behind the dams emitted methane, the equivalent to 64,000 cars a year on the road.
cues.zh: 大壩後面的水庫排放的甲烷相當於道路上每年 64,000 輛汽車的排放量。

cues.text: In 2002, the legacy of colonization produced a horrific outcome.
cues.en: In 2002, the legacy of colonization produced a horrific outcome.
cues.zh: 2002年，殖民主義遺留問題造成了可怕的後果。

cues.text: Over 70,000 adult salmon died on the Klamath River
cues.en: Over 70,000 adult salmon died on the Klamath River
cues.zh: 克拉馬斯河上超過 7 萬條成年鮭魚死亡

cues.text: within the Yurok Reservation, the largest salmon kill in US history.
cues.en: within the Yurok Reservation, the largest salmon kill in US history.
cues.zh: 尤羅克保留地內發生了美國史上最大規模的鮭魚捕殺事件。

cues.text: I was working for tribal fisheries that summer, and the salmon died for two weeks.
cues.en: I was working for tribal fisheries that summer, and the salmon died for two weeks.
cues.zh: 那年夏天我在部落漁業工作，鮭魚死了兩週。

cues.text: By the end of it, their bodies lined the banks of the river,
cues.en: By the end of it, their bodies lined the banks of the river,
cues.zh: 到最後，他們的屍體排列在河岸上，

cues.text: and the river looked and smelled like a war zone.
cues.en: and the river looked and smelled like a war zone.
cues.zh: 這條河看起來、聞起來都像戰區。

cues.text: Standing in a Yurok tribal fisheries boat, I recalled a Yurok myth.
cues.en: Standing in a Yurok tribal fisheries boat, I recalled a Yurok myth.
cues.zh: 站在尤洛克部落的漁船上，我想起了尤洛克的一個神話。

cues.text: If the Klamath salmon die, so too will the Yurok people.
cues.en: If the Klamath salmon die, so too will the Yurok people.
cues.zh: 如果克拉馬斯鮭魚死亡，尤洛克人也會死亡。

cues.text: Because our purpose, our way of life depends on those salmon.
cues.en: Because our purpose, our way of life depends on those salmon.
cues.zh: 因為我們的目的、我們的生活方式取決於那些鮭魚。

cues.text: Was I witnessing the end?
cues.en: Was I witnessing the end?
cues.zh: 我見證了結局嗎？

cues.text: In that moment, I felt my great grandmother move through me like electricity.
cues.en: In that moment, I felt my great grandmother move through me like electricity.
cues.zh: 那一刻，我感覺我的曾祖母像電流一樣在我體內移動。

cues.text: I feel it now.
cues.en: I feel it now.
cues.zh: 我現在感覺到了。

cues.text: And she told me, "It's your turn to fight." And my response?
cues.en: And she told me, "It's your turn to fight." And my response?
cues.zh: 她告訴我，「輪到你戰鬥了。」我的反應呢？

cues.text: I'll go to law school to prevent this kind of ecocide from ever happening again.
cues.en: I'll go to law school to prevent this kind of ecocide from ever happening again.
cues.zh: 我會去法學院，以防止這種生態滅絕再次發生。

cues.text: Now I did not know a lawyer, and I thought they were all rich and famous.
cues.en: Now I did not know a lawyer, and I thought they were all rich and famous.
cues.zh: 現在我不認識律師，我以為他們都是有錢有名的。

cues.text: But that's what I did.
cues.en: But that's what I did.
cues.zh: 但這就是我所做的。

cues.text: And I became my nation's general counsel, the first tribal member and woman to do so.
cues.en: And I became my nation's general counsel, the first tribal member and woman to do so.
cues.zh: 我成為了我們國家的總法律顧問，也是第一位這樣做的部落成員和女性。

cues.text: Thank you.
cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 謝謝。

cues.text: And then I cofounded, with Molly Myers, a real tough Karuk activist,
cues.en: And then I cofounded, with Molly Myers, a real tough Karuk activist,
cues.zh: 然後我和莫莉·邁爾斯（Molly Myers）共同創立了一個真正強硬的卡魯克活動家，

cues.text: the Ridges to Riffles Indigenous Conservation Group.
cues.en: the Ridges to Riffles Indigenous Conservation Group.
cues.zh: 山脊到萊佛斯原住民保育組織。

cues.text: And we moved money and power to better serve the river.
cues.en: And we moved money and power to better serve the river.
cues.zh: 我們投入資金和力量來更好地服務河流。

cues.text: And that was important.
cues.en: And that was important.
cues.zh: 這很重要。

cues.text: The fish kill triggered our duties as Indigenous people
cues.en: The fish kill triggered our duties as Indigenous people
cues.zh: 魚類捕殺引發了我們身為原住民的責任

cues.text: to share the original instructions and work to renew the balance.
cues.en: to share the original instructions and work to renew the balance.
cues.zh: 分享原始指令並努力更新平衡。

cues.text: Indigenous peoples on the Klamath were the first to call for dam removal.
cues.en: Indigenous peoples on the Klamath were the first to call for dam removal.
cues.zh: 克拉馬斯河上的原住民首先呼籲拆除水壩。

cues.text: People thought it was impossible.
cues.en: People thought it was impossible.
cues.zh: 人們認為這是不可能的。

cues.text: A dam removal of this scale had never been done before.
cues.en: A dam removal of this scale had never been done before.
cues.zh: 如此規模的大壩拆除以前從未進行過。

cues.text: Powerful corporations, some of the richest corporations and industries were against us.
cues.en: Powerful corporations, some of the richest corporations and industries were against us.
cues.zh: 強大的公司、一些最富有的公司和行業都反對我們。

cues.text: They said removing the dams would release toxic sediment
cues.en: They said removing the dams would release toxic sediment
cues.zh: 他們說拆除水壩會釋放有毒沉積物

cues.text: and destroy the river for good.
cues.en: and destroy the river for good.
cues.zh: 並永遠摧毀這條河。

cues.text: The odds were against us.
cues.en: The odds were against us.
cues.zh: 形勢對我們不利。

cues.text: But we had something they did not.
cues.en: But we had something they did not.
cues.zh: 但我們有一些他們沒有的東西。

cues.text: The original instructions, thousands of years of traditional knowledge,
cues.en: The original instructions, thousands of years of traditional knowledge,
cues.zh: 原汁原味的說明書，數千年的傳統知識，

cues.text: ancient legal rights, vested in the US Constitution as the supreme law
cues.en: ancient legal rights, vested in the US Constitution as the supreme law
cues.zh: 古老的合法權利，賦予美國憲法為最高法律

cues.text: and our duties and responsibilities to the river, its creatures
cues.en: and our duties and responsibilities to the river, its creatures
cues.zh: 以及我們對河流及其生物的義務和責任

cues.text: and our people, making the Un-Dam the Klamath Movement an unstoppable Indigenous force.
cues.en: and our people, making the Un-Dam the Klamath Movement an unstoppable Indigenous force.
cues.zh: 和我們的人民，使 Un-Dam 克拉馬斯運動成為一股不可阻擋的原住民力量。

cues.text: Yeah. We protested.
cues.en: Yeah. We protested.
cues.zh: 是的。我們抗議。

cues.text: There we go, guys, come on.
cues.en: There we go, guys, come on.
cues.zh: 我們開始了，夥計們，加油。

cues.text: We protested.
cues.en: We protested.
cues.zh: 我們抗議。

cues.text: We built coalitions between Indigenous nations, the Karuk, the Hoopa, the Klamath tribes,
cues.en: We built coalitions between Indigenous nations, the Karuk, the Hoopa, the Klamath tribes,
cues.zh: 我們在原住民族、卡魯克、胡帕、克拉馬斯部落之間建立了聯盟，

cues.text: commercial fishermen, NGOs and states and farmers.
cues.en: commercial fishermen, NGOs and states and farmers.
cues.zh: 商業漁民、非政府組織、國家和農民。

cues.text: We litigated.
cues.en: We litigated.
cues.zh: 我們打官司了。

cues.text: We asserted the tribes’ reserved rights and combined them with modern environmental power and energy law.
cues.en: We asserted the tribes’ reserved rights and combined them with modern environmental power and energy law.
cues.zh: 我們主張部落的保留權利，並將其與現代環境權力和能源法結合。

cues.text: We won on almost every count.
cues.en: We won on almost every count.
cues.zh: 我們幾乎在每一個方面都贏了。

cues.text: Yeah.
cues.en: Yeah.
cues.zh: 是的。

cues.text: And the power company was required to install fish ladders
cues.en: And the power company was required to install fish ladders
cues.zh: 並且要求電力公司安裝魚梯

cues.text: to continue to operate the dams.
cues.en: to continue to operate the dams.
cues.zh: 繼續運作水壩。

cues.text: Empathy overcame fear.
cues.en: Empathy overcame fear.
cues.zh: 同理心戰勝了恐懼。

cues.text: And perhaps for the first time, we shared the original instructions with the newcomers,
cues.en: And perhaps for the first time, we shared the original instructions with the newcomers,
cues.zh: 也許這是我們第一次與新人分享原始說明，

cues.text: and they accepted their shared responsibilities to work to renew the balance.
cues.en: and they accepted their shared responsibilities to work to renew the balance.
cues.zh: 他們承擔了共同的責任，並努力恢復平衡。

cues.text: With our allies and our former enemies, we found a common interest.
cues.en: With our allies and our former enemies, we found a common interest.
cues.zh: 我們與我們的盟友和以前的敵人找到了共同利益。

cues.text: It was cheaper to remove the dams than it was to install the fish ladders.
cues.en: It was cheaper to remove the dams than it was to install the fish ladders.
cues.zh: 拆除水壩比安裝魚梯便宜。

cues.text: Yeah, right?
cues.en: Yeah, right?
cues.zh: 是啊，對吧？

cues.text: Yeah, there's that common interest.
cues.en: Yeah, there's that common interest.
cues.zh: 是的，有共同的興趣。

cues.text: So we worked together to find a path forward,
cues.en: So we worked together to find a path forward,
cues.zh: 所以我們共同努力尋找前進的道路，

cues.text: to restore the river and the balance.
cues.en: to restore the river and the balance.
cues.zh: 恢復河流和平衡。

cues.text: And the outcome was historic.
cues.en: And the outcome was historic.
cues.zh: 結果是歷史性的。

cues.text: A 500 million-dollar settlement agreement for dam removal
cues.en: A 500 million-dollar settlement agreement for dam removal
cues.zh: 5億美元拆除大壩和解協議

cues.text: that equally valued the rights of nature, business and Indigenous peoples.
cues.en: that equally valued the rights of nature, business and Indigenous peoples.
cues.zh: 同樣重視自然、商業和原住民的權利。

cues.text: And it produced the world's largest salmon restoration project
cues.en: And it produced the world's largest salmon restoration project
cues.zh: 並產生了世界上最大的鮭魚恢復專案

cues.text: in world history.
cues.en: in world history.
cues.zh: 在世界歷史上。

cues.text: Yeah.
cues.en: Yeah.
cues.zh: 是的。

cues.text: Feel that, like, oh my God.
cues.en: Feel that, like, oh my God.
cues.zh: 感覺就像，天啊。

cues.text: And also the largest US dam removal project in history.
cues.en: And also the largest US dam removal project in history.
cues.zh: 這也是美國史上最大的水壩拆除工程。

cues.text: In 2023 and 2024, we removed four dams on the Klamath River,
cues.en: In 2023 and 2024, we removed four dams on the Klamath River,
cues.zh: 2023年和2024年，我們拆除了克拉馬斯河上的四座水壩，

cues.text: and restoration across thousands of acres has already begun
cues.en: and restoration across thousands of acres has already begun
cues.zh: 數千英畝的恢復工作已經開始

cues.text: and will continue through 2028.
cues.en: and will continue through 2028.
cues.zh: 並將持續到 2028 年。

cues.text: I stood among tribal leaders when the first dam was breached through a series of explosions.
cues.en: I stood among tribal leaders when the first dam was breached through a series of explosions.
cues.zh: 當第一座水壩因一系列爆炸而決堤時，我站在部落領袖中間。

cues.text: The explosion released a freedom wave, a surge of water into a stretch of river
cues.en: The explosion released a freedom wave, a surge of water into a stretch of river
cues.zh: 爆炸釋放出一股自由浪潮，一股水流湧入河流

cues.text: that had been dewatered for more than a century.
cues.en: that had been dewatered for more than a century.
cues.zh: 已經脫水一個多世紀了。

cues.text: The water moved with such force and confidence, knowing exactly where to flow and how to go,
cues.en: The water moved with such force and confidence, knowing exactly where to flow and how to go,
cues.zh: 水流動得如此有力和自信，確切地知道該流到哪裡以及如何去，

cues.text: and it seemed to declare, "Do not call this a comeback, I have been here for years."
cues.en: and it seemed to declare, "Do not call this a comeback, I have been here for years."
cues.zh: 它似乎在宣告：“不要稱之為捲土重來，我已經在這裡很多年了。”

cues.text: Later, at Iron Gate, the lowest dam, an excavator scooped some final dirt from the dam
cues.en: Later, at Iron Gate, the lowest dam, an excavator scooped some final dirt from the dam
cues.zh: 後來，在最低的大壩鐵門，一臺挖土機從大壩挖出了一些最後的泥土

cues.text: and the water began to go over the structure,
cues.en: and the water began to go over the structure,
cues.zh: 水開始漫過建築物，

cues.text: first as a sparkle, then as a ribbon,
cues.en: first as a sparkle, then as a ribbon,
cues.zh: 首先是閃光，然後是絲帶，

cues.text: and then the river reconnected with itself for the first time in 100 years,
cues.en: and then the river reconnected with itself for the first time in 100 years,
cues.zh: 然後河流一百年來第一次重新連結起來，

cues.text: in a brilliant stream of prosperity.
cues.en: in a brilliant stream of prosperity.
cues.zh: 在輝煌的繁榮之流中。

cues.text: Three days later, the salmon came home and went past historical spawning grounds not accessed in 100 years.
cues.en: Three days later, the salmon came home and went past historical spawning grounds not accessed in 100 years.
cues.zh: 三天後，鮭魚回家並經過100年來無人進入的歷史產卵場。

cues.text: The salmon remembered.
cues.en: The salmon remembered.
cues.zh: 鮭魚想起來了。

cues.text: They remembered.
cues.en: They remembered.
cues.zh: 他們記得。

cues.text: Many did not think that the river could heal,
cues.en: Many did not think that the river could heal,
cues.zh: 許多人不認為這條河可以治癒，

cues.text: but its recovery has been remarkably rapid.
cues.en: but its recovery has been remarkably rapid.
cues.zh: 但其恢復速度卻非常快。

cues.text: A year after dam removal, the river is cleaner and colder and fiercer
cues.en: A year after dam removal, the river is cleaner and colder and fiercer
cues.zh: 大壩拆除一年後，河水更乾淨、更冷、更兇猛

cues.text: and smells sweeter than I have ever known it to be.
cues.en: and smells sweeter than I have ever known it to be.
cues.zh: 而且聞起來比我所知道的更香甜。

cues.text: And the salmon, they are literally jumping for joy.
cues.en: And the salmon, they are literally jumping for joy.
cues.zh: 還有鮭魚，它們簡直高興得跳了起來。

cues.text: And if I wasn't wearing heels, I would jump for joy too.
cues.en: And if I wasn't wearing heels, I would jump for joy too.
cues.zh: 如果我不穿高跟鞋，我也會高興得跳起來。

cues.text: The first year, about 7,000 salmon passed the former dam site.
cues.en: The first year, about 7,000 salmon passed the former dam site.
cues.zh: 第一年，大約 7,000 條鮭魚經過了前壩址。

cues.text: In 2025, 13,000 salmon passed the former dam site
cues.en: In 2025, 13,000 salmon passed the former dam site
cues.zh: 2025年，13,000條鮭魚經過舊壩址

cues.text: and went further into their historical spawning grounds
cues.en: and went further into their historical spawning grounds
cues.zh: 並進一步深入它們歷史上的產卵地

cues.text: they'd been denied.
cues.en: they'd been denied.
cues.zh: 他們被拒絕了。

cues.text: The many Indigenous peoples of the Klamath, whose relationship with salmon had been severed by the dams,
cues.en: The many Indigenous peoples of the Klamath, whose relationship with salmon had been severed by the dams,
cues.zh: 克拉馬斯的許多原住民與鮭魚的關係被水壩切斷了，

cues.text: are welcoming the salmon home and returning to their homelands
cues.en: are welcoming the salmon home and returning to their homelands
cues.zh: 歡迎鮭魚回家並返回家園

cues.text: in historic, trend-setting land-back efforts.
cues.en: in historic, trend-setting land-back efforts.
cues.zh: 參與歷史性的、引領潮流的土地回饋努力。

cues.text: The Yurok tribe and many other tribes are employing tribal members
cues.en: The Yurok tribe and many other tribes are employing tribal members
cues.zh: 尤洛克部落和許多其他部落正在僱用部落成員

cues.text: and non-members, providing living-wage jobs, restoring land in the river.
cues.en: and non-members, providing living-wage jobs, restoring land in the river.
cues.zh: 和非會員，提供維持生計的工作，恢復河流中的土地。

cues.text: These crews have planted -- get this -- 20 billion native seeds,
cues.en: These crews have planted -- get this -- 20 billion native seeds,
cues.zh: 這些工作人員已經種植了——明白了——200億顆本土種子，

cues.text: bringing back -- yeah, yes, 20 billion native seeds.
cues.en: bringing back -- yeah, yes, 20 billion native seeds.
cues.zh: 帶回——是的，是的，200億顆本地種子。

cues.text: And look at these poppies, aren't they gorgeous?
cues.en: And look at these poppies, aren't they gorgeous?
cues.zh: 看看這些罌粟花，它們不是很漂亮嗎？

cues.text: These new ecosystems are bringing back plants and animals,
cues.en: These new ecosystems are bringing back plants and animals,
cues.zh: 這些新的生態系統正在恢復植物和動物，

cues.text: foods and medicines that anchor Indigenous cultures into the future.
cues.en: foods and medicines that anchor Indigenous cultures into the future.
cues.zh: 將原住民文化融入未來的食品和藥品。

cues.text: And these ecosystems have the potential to prevent 800,000 metric tons of CO2 a year over time.
cues.en: And these ecosystems have the potential to prevent 800,000 metric tons of CO2 a year over time.
cues.zh: 隨著時間的推移，這些生態系統每年有可能減少 80 萬噸的二氧化碳排放。

cues.text: Yeah.
cues.en: Yeah.
cues.zh: 是的。

cues.text: So I know many feel that there is no hope
cues.en: So I know many feel that there is no hope
cues.zh: 所以我知道很多人覺得沒有希望

cues.text: for a future on planet Earth because the Earth is too out of balance, too sick.
cues.en: for a future on planet Earth because the Earth is too out of balance, too sick.
cues.zh: 為了地球的未來，因為地球太不平衡了，太病態了。

cues.text: And in that sense of urgency is real.
cues.en: And in that sense of urgency is real.
cues.zh: 從這種意義上來說，緊迫感是真實存在的。

cues.text: But on the Klamath, the river and all life it supports are remembering how to be in balance.
cues.en: But on the Klamath, the river and all life it supports are remembering how to be in balance.
cues.zh: 但在克拉馬斯河上，河流和它所支援的所有生命都在記住如何保持平衡。

cues.text: And this project has helped us remember an important truth.
cues.en: And this project has helped us remember an important truth.
cues.zh: 這個專案幫助我們記住了一個重要的事實。

cues.text: We can heal nature, and when we work with it, it works with us.
cues.en: We can heal nature, and when we work with it, it works with us.
cues.zh: 我們可以治癒大自然，當我們與大自然合作時，大自然也會與我們合作。

cues.text: And it starts with believing in yourself.
cues.en: And it starts with believing in yourself.
cues.zh: 首先要相信自己。

cues.text: So I want you all to remember that what you do matters.
cues.en: So I want you all to remember that what you do matters.
cues.zh: 所以我希望大家記住，你所做的事情很重要。

cues.text: What you do with your life force makes a difference.
cues.en: What you do with your life force makes a difference.
cues.zh: 你用你的生命力所做的事情會產生影響。

cues.text: Treat Indigenous rights not as obstacles to progress
cues.en: Treat Indigenous rights not as obstacles to progress
cues.zh: 不要將原住民權利視為進步的障礙

cues.text: but as critical to it.
cues.en: but as critical to it.
cues.zh: 但對其同樣至關重要。

cues.text: Build mutually beneficial solutions to complex problems.
cues.en: Build mutually beneficial solutions to complex problems.
cues.zh: 為複雜問題建立互利的解決方案。

cues.text: Value ecosystem restoration as a strategic priority to the most pressing problems of our time.
cues.en: Value ecosystem restoration as a strategic priority to the most pressing problems of our time.
cues.zh: 將生態系統恢復視為解決當今時代最迫切問題的策略重點。

cues.text: When we do that, balance is restored, life returns and so does hope.
cues.en: When we do that, balance is restored, life returns and so does hope.
cues.zh: 當我們這樣做時，平衡就會恢復，生活就會恢復，希望也會恢復。

cues.text: Thank you.
cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 謝謝。
